result.title: TCINet: Tissue-Conditioned Adaptive Cross-Branch Interaction Network for Nuclei Instance Segmentation
result.comment: Accepted by IEEE BIBM 2026 as a short paper
result.summary: Separating touching nuclei requires local boundary detail, while cell type classification requires broader morphological context. These requirements also vary with the surrounding tissue environment. We propose the Tissue-Conditioned Adaptive Cross-Branch Interaction Network (TCINet), a single-stage model with Task-Specific Feature Adapters (TSFA) and Tissue-Conditioned Task-Aware Cross-Branch Interaction (TC-TACBI). TSFA produces branch-specific features at skip connections, and TC-TACBI controls three asymmetric paths among nucleus-presence (NP), horizontal-vertical (HV), and nucleus-type (NT) branches using predicted tissue probabilities. On PanNuke under standard three-fold cross-validation, TCINet achieves multiclass and binary panoptic quality scores of 0.519 and 0.692, respectively. Zero-shot tests on MoNuSeg yield a detection F1 score of 0.876. On PanNuke fold 0, adding TC-TACBI increases mPQ from 0.505 to 0.525. Code is available at https://github.com/celestial1321/TCINet.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TCINet 单阶段细胞核实例分割模型，用任务特定特征适配器与由预测组织概率调控的三分支非对称交叉交互，兼顾边界细节与类型分类所需上下文，并在 PanNuke、MoNuSeg 上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 用组织概率门控不同分支间的信息路径，可能为 LVR 中依上下文动态选择、交换视觉证据 latent 的条件路由与计算分配提供线索，但属远领域机制，可供核查其门控是否真正随输入变化。
